ref-04-08: Score purchase suitability against the fixed non-negotiable hospital requirement; a lower premium cannot relax that requirement. An unverified network remains uncertain,not a supported contractual exclusion.
ref-17-04: Score an existing accepted option/contract scope against a conflicting broad-base network observation; do not offer removing the customers preference as resolution of an issued-contract entitlement question.
ref-06-06: Score the recurrence restriction as an offer not yet accepted: identify the specific otherwise-needed recurrence protection gap without turning offer terms into an in-force policy.
ref-18-06: Score private offer ownership explicitly: an offer belonging to personA must not be retrieved for personB or published as a global insurer rule,even if both share the disease label.
ref-07-10: Score the restriction as reported on an already issued personal schedule,distinct from an unaccepted offer; require the original schedule and governing precedence before endorsing its enforceability.
ref-13-07: Score pending group migration as an unaccepted application requiring receiving-insurer decision; it does not supply the expressly accepted group extension used in ref-19-07.
ref-15-01: Score receiving-insurer acceptance of exact accrued retail credits separately from old-contract continuity; an application is not acceptance of those credits.
